question: The battle of Plassey was fought between the East India Company, force headed by Robert Clive, and the Nawab of Bengal, ________ in 1757.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Siraj-Ud-Daulah**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The battle of Plassey was fought between the East India Company, force headed by Robert Clive, and the Nawab of Bengal, **Siraj-Ud-Daulah** in 1757.
 
• This battle marked the beginning of British rule in India.
 
• It was a decisive victory for the British East India Company.
